 Amir Jangoo’s century against Bangladesh has helped the West Indies recover from an early collapse to reach 235-4 on day one of the second cricket test in Sylhet. Jangoo has led the charge with an unbeaten 111. His 131-run partnership with debutant Kevin Wickham was critical for the visitors after they were 27-3. Wickham made 61. Jangoo reached stumps — which was called for bad light — with Justin Greaves on 35. They combined for 77 in the last 19.5 overs.

 AP

 SYLHET, Bangladesh (AP) — Amir Jangoo's century against Bangladesh helped the West Indies recover from an early collapse to reach 235-4 on day one of the second cricket test on Thursday.
 Jangoo led the charge with an unbeaten 111 and his 131-run partnership with debutant Kevin Wickham was critical for the visitors after they were 27-3.
